name: Bigthan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: It was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two chamberlains who sought to lay hand on the king, and yet nothing had been done to honor him for it.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Bigthan and Teresh
cases.charge: Two of the king’s chamberlains, of those which kept the door, being wroth and seeking to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus
cases.preview: While Mordecai sat in the king’s gate, Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s chamberlains who kept the door, were angry and sought to kill king Ahasuerus (Esther 2:21).
